rules: All catalogue weekly windows and every straddled report-cutoff prefix requested.
Every capped multi-day response receives daily child requests in every retained context.
Only response windows ending at or before consuming report cutoff are merged.
RSS timestamps strictly before 00:00UTC report cutoff and within category age.
limits: Google historical search selection/indexing and daily response caps prevent exhaustive coverage.
Contemporary original RSS server responses and publisher article-body vintages are not archived; these are retrieval-time historical search results.
Canonical URL dates and release guards provide conservative selected screening; every narrative claim requires its own-date editorial review.
